notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, design or history for this tower was found in any source read. The record rests on the tnlandforms list (location, elevation, standing; no state number given for this tower) and the 2014 National Register form's extant list. The tnlandforms per-tower pages returned unrelated gambling spam rather than tower details, so the site may have been compromised; a human should check it. The 2014 list is the latest status evidence, so current standing is unverified. Access is unknown. Both sources spell the name Lafollette; the city uses LaFollette, which was not cited.
